headline: United Airlines outage disrupts departures, company says it's fixed
summary: United Airlines suffered a widespread system outage that disrupted departing flights, coming less than a week after a separate nationwide FAA ground stop caused by an air traffic control communications and radar issue. United said at 6:13pm ET that the technology-related problem affecting departures had been fixed.
